A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a new method for the task of plagiarism detection based on character n-gram profile analysis.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed method is able to detect plagiarized documents, even when the plagiarized text is not identical to the original one.
the proposed approach is capable of detecting plagiarism in documents where no external reference corpus is available.
the use of character n-gram features is a viable alternative to traditional word n-gram features for the task of intrinsic plagiarism.
